title: Dragging and dropping a file below another file places the file one cell over to the right of where it should have been placed
line: Files made with Create New or dropped onto the desktop from another app now land in the cell under the pointer instead of one cell to the right.
explanation: FolderView's onMove picks the target cell from the drop point plus the item's drag-image offset, plus half a cell and the icon's vertical centre, so that a dragged icon lands where its icon is. Items with no drag image in this view (new files from Create New, files dropped from another app) get a (0,0) offset but still received the half-cell shift and the stale vertical offset from the last drag, so a click at a cell's centre or right half resolved to the next cell. The change uses the pointer position directly when there is no drag offset; drags inside the desktop keep the existing icon-based logic.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: place new and dropped items in the cell under the pointer

Items without a drag offset, like files made with Create New or dropped
from another app, were still shifted by half a cell and by the icon
offset of the last drag, landing one cell to the right. Use the pointer.

BUG: 518069

media.caption: Right-click at the centre of the empty cell below a.txt, Create New > Text File
Before: the new file lands one cell to the right
Same right-click at the centre of the cell below a.txt
After: the new file lands directly below a.txt
After: right-clicking the right half of the next cell down also creates the file in that cell

review.text: Correctly identifies and fixes the off-by-half-cell placement bug in FolderView.qml's onMove handler for items without an in-view drag offset (Create New and external drops). Using dropPos directly when offset is (0, 0) eliminates both the bogus cellWidth/2 horizontal shift and the stale verticalDropHitscanOffset from the previous internal drag while keeping intentional icon-centered placement for in-desktop drags and preserving RTL handling. Before/after screenshots and regression tests verify Create New and internal drag cases cleanly.
